title: Research sprint goal: Lighter sessions: one shared monitor, quicker hooks, lean unwatched runs
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Findings 2026-10-27 (kb facts): ST-dmon53is, ST-h7ddg4nu, ST-ztsewht6, ST-qqpcgqe7 read claude/hooks.md:203-207 (matching hooks run in parallel, so a sync event waits for the slowest hook; a command in both the project settings and an installed plugin runs twice) and python/interpreter-startup.md:80-84 (a script run directly is recompiled every start, imported modules load from the pyc cache; -B or an unwritable tree means no cache); ST-dktdxpc3 reads python/stdlib-windows-portability.md:89-91 (os.replace of a same-directory temp file publishes a snapshot atomically on POSIX; Windows atomicity unconfirmed). Already in the kb: hooks.md:80-100,139-141,195-200 (SessionStart wait, timeouts, async, -p runs, disableAllHooks), mods.md:109,127,132 (mod timers and redraws). Gap entries: unwritable __pycache__ behaviour and recompile cost (python/interpreter-startup); os.replace atomicity on Windows (python/stdlib-windows-portability).
